campaigns.scope: Five build recipes × four ordinary weapons, fixed seeds, normal movement/dash/coin pickup/purchase input. No direct edits to life, damage, clock, experience or random stream. This demonstrates completion and equipment reachability; it is not a human balance study.

production_build.warning: Existing embedded art makes the Blade chunk exceed the configured 8000 kB Vite warning threshold.

browser.scope: Native menus, physical coin pickup, live non-pausing shop, real keyboard and CDP multitouch, scrolling, exact saves, continuous boss entry and ten-minute deadline. Stationary enemies, on-player coin funding and timeline-edge fixtures are explicit QA fixtures. Fourteen equipment effects on all four weapons are separately exercised in unit simulation tests.
